descriptions.value: In Retry_MtsMessageInPending of MtsMessageController.cpp, there is a possible way to trigger memory exhaustion via leaked message objects due to a logic error. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
